def test_wallet_balance_and_topup():
    _, _, token = create_user_and_get_token()
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

    # Initial balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    data = resp.json()
    assert data["balance"] == 0
    address = data["address"]

    # Topup
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    topup_data = resp.json()
    assert topup_data["address"] == address
    assert topup_data["balance"] > 0
    new_balance = topup_data["balance"]

    # Verify balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == new_balance

    # Negative: topup again
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Negative: no token
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_auth_signup_and_login():
    user = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"

    # Signup
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/signup"), json={"user": user, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert "token" in resp.json()

    # Login
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/login"), json={"user": user, "password": password}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert "token" in resp.json()

    # Invalid login
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/auth/login"), json={"user": user, "password": "wrongpassword"}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_wallet_transfer_success():
    _, _, token_a = create_user_and_get_token()
    _, _, token_b = create_user_and_get_token()
    headers_a = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_a}"}
    headers_b = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_b}"}

    # Topup A
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_a = resp.json()["balance"]
    address_a = resp.json()["address"]
    assert balance_a > 0, "Topup should result in a positive balance"

    # Get B address
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_b = resp.json()["address"]
    balance_b = resp.json()["balance"]

    transfer_amount = balance_a / 2.0

    # Transfer A to B
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": transfer_amount}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_a - transfer_amount

    # Verify A balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_a - transfer_amount

    # Verify B balance
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["balance"] == balance_b + transfer_amount

    # Transfer 0 to B (no-op)
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": 0}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Transfer to self (no-op)
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_a, "amount": transfer_amount}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_wallet_transfer_failures():
    _, _, token_a = create_user_and_get_token()
    _, _, token_b = create_user_and_get_token()
    headers_a = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_a}"}
    headers_b = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token_b}"}

    # Topup A
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/topup"), headers=headers_a, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    balance_a = resp.json()["balance"]

    # Get B address
    resp = requests.get(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/balance"), headers=headers_b, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    address_b = resp.json()["address"]

    # Insufficient funds
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": balance_a + 100.0}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Negative amount
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b, "amount": -10.0}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Non-existent recipient
    fake_address = f"addr_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": fake_address, "amount": 1.0}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Missing 'to'
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"amount": 1.0}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Missing 'amount'
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), headers=headers_a, json={"to": address_b}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 400, f"Expected 400, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Missing token
    resp = requests.post(get_url("gateway", "/wallet/transfer"), json={"to": address_b, "amount": 1.0}, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
